name: HF Propagation
description: Live HF radio propagation dashboard for radio amateurs: band conditions with a 24-hour outlook and best operating windows, local MUF (ionosonde calibrated), absorption, noise floor, sun and grey line, SFI, SSN, Kp, A, X-ray, solar wind and NOAA space weather scales. Data from N0NBH/HamQSL, NOAA SWPC and KC2G.
